source.notes: in.player, in.tool, in.target are object specs (class, id, wcid, wt = WeenieType, i/f/b/s/d/iid property rows [id, value], sk = skills [skill, SAC, InitLevel, LevelFromPP]; a Player's six attributes are InitLevel 100). in.skill and in.salvage_type build the Recipe. out.chance is the double or null; out.tool_iw and out.target_iw are ItemWorkmanship afterwards (the Workmanship getter rewrites an old encoding). Inputs from System.Random(5901).
